focused.visualCheck: Blank page matches PDFium pixel-for-pixel. The cyclic text forms a clipping mask; the later red fill remains hidden.

behavior: Compatibility rendering catches only the dedicated TrueType glyph recursion/depth exception, substitutes an empty outline, reports a diagnostic, and preserves text advance. Empty clipping coverage prevents later fills from leaking. Regression cases check clipping, ordinary text, restored graphics state, and repeat rendering.
preservedChecks: Strict rendering and direct outline reads still throw a FormatException subtype. Other font exceptions and outline limits remain unchanged.
limitations: Damaged glyph shapes are omitted, not reconstructed. Single-file timing is not throughput; full corpus totals have not been rerun.
